product_scope: Parent-managed child profiles, daily chores and tasks, Parent PIN approval, reward coins and custom rewards on a parent-owned device
release_boundaries: Do not describe Parent Quest as Guardian or as a location or safety app.
Do not claim child accounts, messaging, location tracking, banking or cash rewards.
Do not edit the root homepage or root sitemap during prototype work.
Do not edit, stage or release Vanta Workforce.
